title: Erasmus Mundus Scholarships: Courses, Funding and Application Steps
content:
Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters combine study across partner institutions. Apply through the specific consortium, where you can check the curriculum, scholarship availability and the deadlines for your applicant category.

Start with the consortium

Find the specific joint master in the official catalogue, then use its own website to check partner institutions, curriculum, entry requirements and application route. The participating universities and study itinerary differ between programmes. Verify where you would study and how the degrees or qualifications are awarded.

Distinguish scholarship selection from admission

Admission to a course does not automatically include an Erasmus Mundus scholarship. Check which awards are available for the intake, what costs they cover and whether the funding deadline differs from other application deadlines. Read any separate requirements for your applicant category.

Prepare a focused application

Map your documents against the programme checklist: academic records, language evidence, references and the requested statement. Explain your fit with the course itself rather than writing a generic scholarship essay. Keep submission confirmations and follow the consortium instructions for missing documents or updates.

Official information

  • Official Erasmus Mundus information

Check the itinerary and the award separately

For a joint master, understand where each part of the course takes place, what academic requirements apply and how the programme assesses applicants. Then read the scholarship rules for the same intake. Keep a document table with the recipient and deadline for each item. If several institutions appear in the programme, follow the consortium’s application instructions rather than submitting to every university independently. A joint study experience can be valuable, but its mobility, housing and funding arrangements need practical planning alongside the academic application.

Relevant listings and guides on NextApply

To see how these questions apply to a real listing, review Erasmus Mundus EMHRPP Scholarship 2027 - Fully Funded Human Rights Master's. Compare its stated requirements with your own preparation and check the official source before applying.

You can also browse Erasmus Mundus EMHRPP Consortium on NextApply and the scholarships category. Listings and recruitment windows can change.
